items.title: Fujifilm UK pension scheme completes £46m buy-in with Royal London
items.summary: The Fujifilm UK Limited Pension and Life Assurance Scheme has secured a £46m bulk purchase annuity transaction with Royal London for 484 members.

items.title: Fidelity International adds all country equity strategy to active ETF range
items.summary: Fidelity International has expanded its active exchange-traded fund range with the addition of an all country equity strategy carrying an ongoing charge figure of 0.25%.

items.title: Patria Private Equity appoints Nigel Reynolds as non-executive director
items.summary: Patria Private Equity trust has appointed former PwC professional Nigel Reynolds as a non-executive director.

items.title: Rob Gibbs named PoloWorks Holdings CEO to lead Pro Global integration
items.summary: Marco Capital has appointed former SiriusPoint and RSA leader Rob Gibbs as CEO of PoloWorks Holdings to oversee its upcoming integration with Pro Global.

items.title: Female underwriters at Lloyd's seek senior sponsorship for career progression
items.summary: Research from the Lloyd’s market indicates that more than two-thirds of women working there view senior leadership sponsorship as essential for advancing into senior underwriting roles.

items.title: Howden highlights data centre outage risks and protection gaps
items.summary: A new report from Howden examines the financial impact of data centre outages and points to opportunities for parametric and non-damage business interruption cover.
